name: Voices
description: Tells voices apart: every spoken line gets a voice, a known one or a new "voice #3". Tell AAC who a voice is ("that's Anna", "that's the guy from channel X, a video") and it keeps that. Voice prints stay in Home Assistant; unnamed voices are forgotten after a few days. Not for security: voices can be imitated.
instructions: Every spoken line carries its voice. Unknown voices are 'voice #n'. When the owner tells you who a voice is (a person in the home, a guest, or someone from a video or the TV), use name_voice with kind person or media and a short note (e.g. the channel). Voices of kind media are not talking to you.

match.title: Same voice from (percent similar)
match.help: Higher = stricter: fewer mix-ups, but the same person may get two voices.

min_seconds.title: Shortest line for a voice print (seconds)
min_seconds.help: Very short lines ("yes") are too short to recognize a voice.

setup.title: Add voice prints
setup.hint: Run the AAC senses service (services/aac_senses in the AAC repository) on a machine, add it under Compute and put it into the voice pool's Voice prints role.
